attributes.board_name: Connecticut Board of Examiners for Nursing / Department of Public Health

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses (incl. online) offered or approved by ANA, Connecticut Hospital Association, Connecticut Nurses Association, Connecticut League for Nursing, a specialty nursing society or equivalent, hospital/health-care institution offerings, regionally accredited academic institutions, state or local health departments
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first license renewal.
rules.audit_note: Keep certificates 3 years; submit within 45 days of a DPH request.
rules.notes: 50 hours in the 24 months before renewal; APRN licenses renew yearly. 1 hour each: infectious diseases incl. HIV/AIDS, risk management, sexual assault (no code), domestic violence, cultural competency, substance abuse incl. prescribing controlled substances and pain management.
rules.rule_quote: (b) Except as provided in this section, for registration periods beginning on and after October 1, 2014, a licensee applying for license renewal shall earn a minimum of fifty contact hours of continuing education within the preceding twenty-four-month period.
